messages:
Lila (Customer): Hi team — GroveHome support. We want to pilot a returns-note summarizer (EN + occasional DE). Goal: cut manual review by ~60% and output structured fields (reason_code, item_condition, refund_recommendation). Pilot needed in 6 weeks. Any privacy blockers?
Asha (CSM): thanks Lila. Quick q: do notes include phone numbers, partial addresses, or order ids? Hosted preferred or Private/Dedicated?
Lila (Customer): Notes include phone numbers and short order ids. Hosted preferred for speed but open to Dedicated if required.
Tom (Solutions): Plan: 1) neutralize a 5k sample set 2) quality eval (F1 per field, extraction accuracy) 3) safety checks (PII leakage + refund hallucination) 4) pilot as canary endpoint.
Raj (Data Eng): I can provide a neutralization script to replace phones/ids with tokens and a schema for extractor outputs.
Noor (Safety): Flag: warranty/medical mentions show up occasionally. Require PII detection (NER recall >= 0.95), 10 targeted hallucination prompts for refund amounts, and logs retention policy (30d). If Dedicated chosen, require KMS-backed keys.
Camila (AE): heads-up GroveHome is in renewal cycle. Pilot success materially impacts renewal. Any >3 week slip triggers escalation.
Asha (CSM): Lila, please upload a neutralized CSV and a brief label spec, plus acceptance thresholds (e.g., F1 >= 0.85?).
Lila (Customer): Uploading now: "grove_returns_5k_neutral.csv" and "grove_label_spec.md". Targets: field F1 >= 0.86, structured precision >= 0.9.
deploy-bot: ticket CS-11789 created and assigned to tom.solutions. Slot requested for perf+quality eval next Wed.
Tom (Solutions): sample eval command I'll run:
```bash
redwood eval run --model redwood-13b-slim --task extract --dataset grove_returns_5k_neutral.csv --metrics f1,precision,recall --output reports/grove_pilot_report.json
```
Tom (Solutions): latency target single-record <150ms. If hosted tail is unstable we'll propose Dedicated + micro-batching. I'll include perf vs cost delta in the report.
Noor (Safety): also add redaction transform in ingestion and a 10-item synthetic test set to catch numeric hallucinations.
Raj (Data Eng): sharing neutralization script and Helm job snippet in the repo.
Asha (CSM): scheduling 30-min kickoff Mon 10am PT. I'll prepare an internal pre-brief and a renewal one-pager.
Camila (AE): cc me on invites and share the one-pager.
Lila (Customer): thanks — labeling done by Fri, will join kickoff.
Asha (CSM): action items: Lila upload (L), Raj script (R), Noor safety tests (N), Tom evals + perf/cost (T), Asha kickoff + renewal one-pager (A). Follow-up after evals. :white_check_mark:
